import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv',
                   usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode', 'er_status', 'pr_status', 'her2_ihc_status'])
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
# Normalize index: strip version
expr.index = expr.index.to_series().str.split('.').str[0]

# 2. Define subtypes: clear positives/negatives only
clin = clin[clin['er_status'].isin(['Positive','Negative']) &
            clin['pr_status'].isin(['Positive','Negative']) &
            clin['her2_ihc_status'].isin(['Positive','Negative'])].copy()
clin['subtype'] = np.where(
    (clin['er_status']=='Negative') & (clin['pr_status']=='Negative') & (clin['her2_ihc_status']=='Negative'),
    'Triple-negative', 'Luminal')

# 3. Map symbols to Ensembl IDs
symbol_to_ensembl = {
    'PDCD1': 'ENSG00000188389',  # PD-1
    'CD274': 'ENSG00000120217',  # PD-L1
    'CTLA4': 'ENSG00000163599',
    'LAG3': 'ENSG00000137572'
}
# Identify available genes
available = {g: eid for g, eid in symbol_to_ensembl.items() if eid in expr.index}
missing = set(symbol_to_ensembl.values()) - set(available.values())
if missing:
    print(f"Warning: The following Ensembl IDs are missing in expression data and will be excluded: {missing}")
genes = list(available.keys())
enids = list(available.values())

# 4. Extract expression for target genes
gene_expr = expr.loc[enids].copy()
gene_expr.index = genes  # rename rows to gene symbols

gene_expr = gene_expr.T
gene_expr.index.name = 'bcr_patient_barcode'

# Merge clinical and expression
df = clin.merge(gene_expr, left_on='bcr_patient_barcode', right_index=True)

# 5-6. Statistical tests and effect sizes
results = []
for g in genes:
    grp_tn = df[df['subtype']=='Triple-negative'][g].dropna()
    grp_lum = df[df['subtype']=='Luminal'][g].dropna()
    stat, p = mannwhitneyu(grp_tn, grp_lum, alternative='two-sided')
    n1, n2 = len(grp_tn), len(grp_lum)
    greater = sum(x>y for x in grp_tn for y in grp_lum)
    less = sum(x<y for x in grp_tn for y in grp_lum)
    delta = (greater - less) / (n1 * n2)
    results.append({
        'gene': g,
        'median_triple_neg': np.median(grp_tn),
        'median_luminal': np.median(grp_lum),
        'U_stat': stat,
        'p_value': p,
        'cliffs_delta': delta
    })
# FDR correction
pvals = [r['p_value'] for r in results]
_, fdrs, _, _ = multipletests(pvals, method='fdr_bh')
for r, fdr in zip(results, fdrs): r['FDR'] = fdr

# 7. Print summary table
res_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
print("\nSummary of expression differences by subtype:")
print(res_df[['gene','median_triple_neg','median_luminal','U_stat','p_value','FDR','cliffs_delta']])

# 8. Violin plots
melted = df.melt(id_vars=['bcr_patient_barcode','subtype'], value_vars=genes,
                 var_name='gene', value_name='expression')
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='gene', y='expression', hue='subtype', data=melted,
               split=True, inner='quartile', palette='Set2')
sns.stripplot(x='gene', y='expression', hue='subtype', data=melted,
              dodge=True, color='k', alpha=0.3, size=2, legend=False)
plt.title('Immune Checkpoint Gene Expression by Subtype')
plt.legend(title='Subtype')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv',
                   usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode', 'er_status', 'pr_status', 'her2_ihc_status'])
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
# Normalize index: strip version
expr.index = expr.index.to_series().str.split('.').str[0]

# 2. Define subtypes: clear positives/negatives only
clin = clin[clin['er_status'].isin(['Positive','Negative']) &
            clin['pr_status'].isin(['Positive','Negative']) &
            clin['her2_ihc_status'].isin(['Positive','Negative'])].copy()
clin['subtype'] = np.where(
    (clin['er_status']=='Negative') & (clin['pr_status']=='Negative') & (clin['her2_ihc_status']=='Negative'),
    'Triple-negative', 'Luminal')

# 3. Map symbols to Ensembl IDs
symbol_to_ensembl = {
    'PDCD1': 'ENSG00000188389',  # PD-1
    'CD274': 'ENSG00000120217',  # PD-L1
    'CTLA4': 'ENSG00000163599',
    'LAG3': 'ENSG00000137572'
}
# Identify available genes
available = {g: eid for g, eid in symbol_to_ensembl.items() if eid in expr.index}
missing = set(symbol_to_ensembl.values()) - set(available.values())
if missing:
    print(f"Warning: The following Ensembl IDs are missing in expression data and will be excluded: {missing}")
genes = list(available.keys())
enids = list(available.values())

# 4. Extract expression for target genes
gene_expr = expr.loc[enids].copy()
gene_expr.index = genes  # rename rows to gene symbols

gene_expr = gene_expr.T
gene_expr.index.name = 'bcr_patient_barcode'

# Merge clinical and expression
df = clin.merge(gene_expr, left_on='bcr_patient_barcode', right_index=True)

# 5-6. Statistical tests and effect sizes
results = []
for g in genes:
    grp_tn = df[df['subtype']=='Triple-negative'][g].dropna()
